## What changed
- **`.github/workflows/shiki-cca-completion.yml`** — In the `Enforce MergeGate` step, hoisted the `MERGED_PRS` resolution **out of** the `<!-- shiki:post_merge_reconcile -->` marker conditional so it runs for **every judged PR**. It now resolves the value byte-for-byte the same way the `Prepare CCA context` step already does: task id via the same `mergegate_check.py` semantics → **BASE snapshot's** `expected_pr` (`.shiki/gha/base-shiki/.shiki/tasks/<id>.json`, a field the PR head cannot forge) → included only when `gh pr view` reports state `MERGED`. Fails closed to `""`.
- **`tests/test_policy_job_merged_prs.py`** (new) — 5 shape assertions: resolution not nested in the marker test; read from base snapshot not head; included only when MERGED; parity with `Prepare CCA context` (so `post_merge_reconcile` PRs receive the same value); and a wiring-completeness enumeration requiring every `mergegate_check.py`/`guardian_approval_signal.py` invocation to carry both `--base-shiki` and `--merged-prs`.

`post_merge_reconcile` behaviour is unchanged: it flows through the identical resolution steps, so its `--merged-prs` value is exactly what it was — the change is purely additive.
